subject: Post-demo: SDK + Streaming Build playbook (MAP draft & owners)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@careloop.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Post-demo: SDK + Streaming Build playbook (MAP draft & owners)

Hi Aisha — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone focused on the integration build so we can align on owners and target close.

TL;DR: CareLoop wants a production-ready SDK integration that supports streaming responses, tool-calls for EHR lookups, and structured JSON outputs for downstream services. We sketched a MAP in the demo; attaching a draft spreadsheet and a short SDK playbook.

Proposed integration-build milestones (high level):
- Milestone 1 — SDK onboarding & sample app (owner: CareLoop eng) — target: 2 weeks after contract
- Milestone 2 — Streaming + prefix/KV caching tests (owner: Redwood SE) — target: 3 weeks after contract
- Milestone 3 — Tool-calling integration (EHR lookup) & auth flow (owner: CareLoop + Redwood) — target: 4–5 weeks
- Milestone 4 — Structured outputs schema & contract tests (owner: CareLoop data team) — target: 5 weeks
- Milestone 5 — Pilot rollout & monitoring (owner: Redwood CS + CareLoop SRE) — target: 6–7 weeks

Dependencies / risks:
- Procurement timeline (PO + security review) — blocks start date
- Test EHR environment access for tool-calls (CareLoop to provision sandbox)
- Non-prod data retention policy for streaming logs (need audit confirmation)

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm target close/contract sign date window? (we proposed end of July in the demo)
2) Who will own the CareLoop SDK onboarding milestone (name + email)?
3) Can procurement confirm sandbox access timeline and any special compliance docs?

I've attached a MAP draft (spreadsheet) and a short SDK playbook with code snippets + streaming examples. Sean and Dev are on CC — Sean will lead the streaming tests and Dev will draft the integration checklist for the SDK.

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP with your answers and circulate a version with explicit dates/owners.

— Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: CareLoop_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), sdk_integration_playbook_v0.9.pdf (pdf)

From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@careloop.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@careloop.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 13:44:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SDK + Streaming Build playbook (MAP draft & owners)

Thanks Neha — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement: PO and legal approval are likely to take 3–4 weeks (we have a vendor review on 6/22). Procurement team is CC’d (procurement@careloop.com) — they’ll share the vendor questionnaire and timing.
- Sandbox/EHR access: our platform team can provision a read-only test instance but we need Redwood to confirm the auth flow requirements (OAuth vs API key) so the team sets scopes correctly.
- Target close: end-of-July is realistic if procurement moves quickly; if not we might spill into mid-August.

Owners on our side: 
- SDK onboarding: Priya Rao (priya.rao@careloop.com) — she’ll be primary engineer
- Data/schema: Tom Hsu (tom.hsu@careloop.com) — agrees to draft expected JSON schema for structured outputs
- SRE/pilot: Kara Nguyen (kara.nguyen@careloop.com)

Please add Priya/Tom/Kara to the MAP when you circulate. We’ll look at the playbook and map internal timelines after procurement confirms the vendor review outcome.

Best,
Aisha
Head of Product | CareLoop Inc.

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@careloop.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SDK + Streaming Build playbook (MAP draft & owners)

On Mon, Jun 14, 2026 at 10:02 AM Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> TL;DR: CareLoop wants a production-ready SDK integration that supports streaming responses, tool-calls for EHR lookups, and structured JSON outputs for downstream services.

Thanks — quick technical notes and a proposed owner split from the SE side: 
- Redwood responsibilities (SE/Engineering):
  * Implement streaming tests using our continuous-batch runner + sample client (I’ll own test harness and perf targets).
  * Tool-calling stub & auth patterns (Dev will provide a sample tool adapter and OAuth guidance).
  * Monitoring hooks and structured-output validators (we’ll provide schema validator tools).
- CareLoop responsibilities (Customer):
  * Sandbox EHR credentials and sample payloads (Priya).
  * Finalize structured-output schema and acceptance tests (Tom).
  * Pilot user identification and success criteria (Kara).

Proposed dates (assuming sign by 7/2):
- Week 1 (7/5–7/9): SDK onboarding & sample app — owner: Priya (CareLoop); Redwood provides starter repo
- Week 2 (7/12–7/16): Streaming perf tests & KV caching — owner: Sean (Redwood)
- Week 3 (7/19–7/23): Tool-calls integration + auth — owner: Dev (Redwood) + Priya
- Week 4 (7/26–7/30): Schema lock & contract tests — owner: Tom (CareLoop)
- Week 5 (8/2–8/6): Pilot rollout validation — owner: Kara (CareLoop) + Marissa (Redwood CS)

I’ll spin up a short test plan in the shared Drive and attach a checklist. One ask for procurement: if there are any special IP or logging restrictions we need to be aware of (especially around streaming token logs), flag them now so we can scope the pilot accordingly.

— Sean
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@careloop.com>, priya.rao@careloop.com, tom.hsu@careloop.com, kara.nguyen@careloop.com
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@careloop.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: MAP v1 (integration playbook + owners) — please review

Hi all — attaching MAP v1 (spreadsheet) and SDK playbook (pdf). I updated owners per replies and added the week-by-week target schedule assuming EoS sign 7/2. Highlights:
- Added Priya/Tom/Kara as CareLoop owners as requested.
- Noted procurement gate: vendor review 6/22 — if that slips we push all dates +2 weeks.
- Dependency: CareLoop to provide sandbox credentials and sample payloads by 6/25 to keep Week 1 on track.

Action items for this week (close by Fri 6/18):
1) Procurement: confirm vendor-review outcome and share questionnaire OR target PO date. (procurement@careloop.com)
2) Priya: confirm you can run the starter app and provide a contact for access issues.
3) Tom: draft the initial structured-output schema (1-2 page doc) and drop in the Drive link.
4) Redwood (Sean/Dev): prepare streaming test harness and sample tool adapter (ETA 6/18).

If everyone is aligned I’ll publish a MAP v1.1 with firm dates and the HubSpot deal updated.

Thanks — Neha

From: procurement@careloop.com <procurement@careloop.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@careloop.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP v1 (integration playbook + owners) — vendor review update

Neha / Aisha — procurement update: vendor review scheduled 6/22; legal has one standard data-processing clause they may request to edit. Expect PO issuance in 3 weeks post-review if there are no escalations. No PII expected in the sandbox, but security will request details on log retention and access controls. Please add a short summary of logging policy in the Drive link and we’ll close the loop after the review.

Procurement Team | CareLoop Inc.
Attachments: CareLoop_vendor_questionnaire.pdf
